text:
Maya (CSM): FYI — MosaicDocs flagged by health alerts. Summarization route (/doc/summarize) DAU down ~49% WoW, active seats 29 -> 11. Renewal ~5 weeks. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/metrics/mosaicdocs

Omar (CS Ops): Pulled the traces 0% fewer /doc/summarize calls. Embedding and rerank routes steady. No 5xx, but p95 latency for summarize jumped 650ms -> 1.3s over 8 days. Retries increased.

Pri (AE): Who's the champion? Any procurement or RFP?

Maya (CSM): Champion (Lydia) moved to another vendor last sprint. New contact is Head of ML, Connor, who replied "we're evaluating consolidation options; running a competitor POC". Finance asked for unit-cost justification yesterday.

Jules (Product): We shipped a cost-optimized variant 15 days ago that changes default max_output_tokens and enables early termination on heuristics for the summarize route. If MosaicDocs was auto-routed, that fits the "short summaries" reports. I'll check routing history for account mosaic-prod around 1827700000-1827780000.

Rae (Support): Created ticket M-3344. Connor sent a sample payload: {"endpoint":"/doc/summarize","model":"rw-summarize-1","prompt":"Summarize the attached contract...","max_output_tokens":150,"batch":1}. He attached a screen clip showing mid-sentence cutoffs.

Pri (AE): This is classic churn risk: champion gone + competitor POC + procurement pressure. Suggest we propose a short stabilization runway: 14-day Dedicated preview with throughput credits and a 99.9% availability guardrail. Can legal fast-track a short SOW?

Maya (CSM): Customer also reported "inconsistent bulletization" (sometimes full bullets, sometimes abrupt ends). Could be the token-budgeting variant. Jules, any variant rollouts across regions?

Jules (Product): Variant rolled globally but only for traffic labeled "low_cost.*". I'll confirm if mosaic-prod matched that label. If so, we can A/B 15% traffic to prior variant to measure "complete summary" rate.

Omar (CS Ops): SDK sniff: they upgraded to client-sdk v2.2 last month which changed retry/backoff. If they also capped concurrency on their side, the combination can raise retries and apparent latency. Their infra note says they set concurrency_limit=6 on 1827765000.

Rae (Support): Repro plan: I'll run their sample prompt in our sandbox with both variants and v2.2/v2.1 SDKs to see truncation. I'll log responses and attach to M-3344.

Pri (AE): I'll open exec intro and pitch the stabilization runway tonight. Also looping SalesOps for discount guardrails.

SalesOpsBot: FYI @Pri: Standard pilot discount cap is 25% for quick trials; exceptions require SalesOps approval. Filing approval request now.

Maya (CSM): Proposed immediate action list: 1) Pri: exec intro + pilot proposal by EOD (owner); 2) Jules: confirm routing + prepare A/B revert plan by tomorrow 11am PT (owner); 3) Omar/Rae: reproduce truncation across variants + SDK versions and confirm concurrency impact by 3pm (owners); 4) Maya: draft short customer note + ROI summary for finance by tomorrow noon. If revert shows improvement, propose temporary Dedicated window as mitigation.

Jules (Product): Noted. If customer consents, I'll run a 2-hr A/B test (15% traffic to prior variant) and collect metrics: full_output_rate, p95, tokens_per_call. ETA initial data in 90m after test.

Omar (CS Ops): Repro attempt started. Quick check: running their sample with current variant => cutoff at ~127 tokens on average. Prior variant => typically 230+ tokens. Collecting traces now.

Rae (Support): Sandbox repro attached to M-3344. Truncation reproducible on current variant with v2.2; on v2.1 difference smaller but still present if concurrency is low.

Pri (AE): I'll ping Connor for permission to run a light A/B test and request a temporary bump in concurrency for 2 hours for the test. Also asking for a brief 20-min exec call.

Maya (CSM): Owners confirmed. If Connor agrees to the A/B test and we show clear improvement, we'll push the 14-day Dedicated preview with credits and a short SOW. Legal, SalesOps, Finance 1: ask for fast-track review.

Jules (Product): If we get permission, I'll instrument a dashboard tile for "complete_summary_pct" and link it to the exec report.

SalesOpsBot: Approval request submitted. ETA for approval 4 business hours.

Omar (CS Ops): Update: traces show increased retry spikes correlate with reduced client concurrency. We'll include retry metrics in the customer note.

Rae (Support): I'll summarize sandbox artifacts and attach a short snippet in M-3344: 

```
Request: {"model":"rw-summarize-1","max_output_tokens":150}
Response (current variant): "...the agreement terminates when"
Response (prior variant): "...the agreement terminates when the party providing notice has fulfilled all obligations, including..."
```

Pri (AE): Connor just replied: "OK to run A/B test and temporary bump for 2 hours. We'll do exec sync after initial results." I'm scheduling a 20-min call.

Maya (CSM): Great. Everyone please post brief updates in this thread only. We'll aim to get measurable improvement before renewal conversations. :thumbsup:
